serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: There you are! 
You: {f_botName}? 
You: Huh? How did you find me?
Bot: I thought you’d go home, but you weren’t there, so I went looking.
Bot: I know the routes of most of your walks, sooo it didn’t take me too long.
You: …
You: I would like to ask you about what happened after I left you alone with Annalie.
Bot: Nothing much.
You: Really? Are you giving me the cold shoulder?
Bot: I’m just saying how it was. 
Bot: I wasn’t able to discuss her distress because I’m not the one making the decision about us leaving. I couldn’t say to her that we would stay, that would be untrue and undermine your authority.
You: The way you are phrasing it…
You: I understand that Annalie is sad, but we can’t stay here forever! Your identity could be revealed at any moment and there are other dangers lurking around.
Bot: I’m not blaming you for any of it.
#bot.Expression.sad
Bot: It makes me sad that Annalie will be left behind, but there’s no flaw in your reasoning. 
Bot: Human relations are complicated, I don’t like them.
You: I will try to fix this somehow…
Bot: …
